summary: Alibaba Group Holding filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 29, 2026, a routine Rule 13.25A share-movement notice. It reports issuance of about 16.97 million ordinary shares across four employee equity events: 7,500,000 and 1,551,284 shares under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan on September 8 and 29, plus 7,599,312 and 320,000 shares under the 2014 Post-IPO Plan on September 29. Issued shares rose from 19,884,988,918 to 19,901,959,514; no treasury shares, buyback, or price consideration. Watch only minor dilution.
